leads.title: Product Specialist
leads.snippet: Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room. YOUR MISSION Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform. Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person.
